$comment: Generated by flexengine/api/tools/gen_reason_codes.py; do not edit by hand. CP-2 reason-code registry.

fields.detail: embedded in another entry's field (e.g. FE-REC-002 'artefact rejected: {detail}')

rules: Codes are stable (never reused or renumbered). The engine reports text only in v1alpha1; a future status field `reasonCode` (additive) will carry the code. A text matches the entry whose pattern fullmatches it; when several do, the most specific one (most literal characters) wins (flexengine2.contracts.reason_code).
